title: Supernatural: Dean Winchester #2
desc:
Dean teams up with the mysterious FLORIDA MAN to hunt down something even more mysterious: THE SHADOW MAN, a horrifying entity who will kill\s thousands if Dean can't figure out how to stop it from jumping from body to body!

Dean's solo adventures continue in this all-new epic from CHUCK BROWN (Bitter Root) and RAPHA LOBOSCO (Mumm-Ra The Ever-Living)!
